acceptanceCriteria: On macOS with multiple installations sharing com.google.chrome.for.testing, getApp called with one exact .app path returns a binding for that application or a bounded actionable error within the caller timeout.
The timeout_ms supplied by the caller bounds getApp wall time; a 20000 ms request cannot block for several minutes.
Display-name and bundle-identifier ambiguity remains distinct from binding failure and returns the candidate paths promptly.
A regression test covers an exact-path app launch/bind with duplicate bundle identifiers and verifies that failed binding does not leave the launched application running.
body: Confirmed unified-computer-use macOS binding defect observed 2026-10-11 while verifying a native HTML select. Reproduction A: cua.getApp("Google Chrome for Testing") against a headed Playwright browser stalled for about 443 seconds and was user-interrupted; no keyboard input was sent. A later bundle-identifier lookup correctly returned immediate ambiguity with three installed app paths, which is separate expected behavior. Reproduction B: with no fixture server running, cua.getApp called with the exact Playwright 1.60.0 app path /Users/russelllewis/Library/Caches/ms-playwright/chromium-1223/chrome-mac-arm64/Google Chrome for Testing.app and timeout_ms=20000 returned Computer Use server error -10005 timeoutReached after about 486 seconds; the binding variable remained undefined. The exact app process was launched near the end of the wait and had to be retired explicitly. Environment: macOS 26.6.2 build 25G83, Chrome for Testing 148.0.7778.96. Expected: exact path selects one installation, returns a native App binding promptly, honors timeout_ms, and cleans up a launch when binding fails. Actual: multi-minute unbounded stall and orphaned launched app. This is a tooling defect, not evidence about Beamfall product behavior or native-select Escape handling.

completion.reason: EXTERNAL disposition (owner delegated 2026-10-21): the stall and ignored timeout are in the external Computer Use getApp, not in this repository; device lane beamfall/corvint#1425 found no Corvint code path. Track upstream; reopen only if a Corvint workaround is needed. Decision record sha256 c1a03aa192304d85d99c12bb42f1adceb657c333b524de54dc20c80826581ec7.

title: macOS computer use exact-path getApp stalls and ignores timeout
